brief: Professional calculation and compliance software for low-voltage electrical systems (IEC 60364 / IEC 61439-2). Sizing building loads, MDB panel breakers, cables, voltage drop, and protection coordination for MEP consultants and panel builders.
criteria: Success: immediate letter recognition for ProCal, authentic 3-phase busbar engineering DNA, scales flawlessly from 16px favicon to desktop CAD header, works in one-colour and dark mode.

concepts.name: The Phase Monogram
concepts.idea: An architectural capital P featuring a Midnight Slate busbar stem and concentric phase conductors.
rationale: Unmistakable capital 'P' silhouette provides instant brand recognition at every scale
Encodes 3-phase electrical distribution: L1 outer loop, L2 middle tap, and L3 return
45-degree chamfered terminal lug at stem base reflects heavy copper busbars in switchgear
Scored 100/100 production-readiness with zero geometry or angle errors

recommendation: The Phase Monogram — authoritative, distinctive, and built for decades of professional engineering trust.
next_steps: Vector masters delivered in SVG and high-resolution PNG
Web icon kit (favicon.ico, apple-touch-icon, webmanifest) deployed to app
Brand guidelines and color specifications documented
